participation.context: Refused the second gold, answered Drayton, and bought the quire.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Confessed the order of the names, and gave Raleigh eight months and a story.
participation.name: Michael Drayton

participation.context: Would not buy the tall tale, and walked on toward the Theatre.
participation.name: George Bryan

relations.quote: Eight months, and he comes home with a story.

story.body: You let the gold shrink. You asked the pillar for a man off the ship and got none. You paid fivepence for a quire and did not open the coffer.

title: Kept the small tale and paid fivepence

participation.context: Read the phrase, paid, and carried blank paper out of the yard.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the phrase. You did not take a title off the sheet. You left with a quire that had nothing on it.

title: Took the phrase and the blank paper

participation.context: Repeated the day's sentence, and did not write on the quire.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the story was a living, and that your own day had not opened the coffer. You stopped.

title: Said the story was a living, and stopped
